title: a3-lift-rule output
description: One lifted rule, from any of the three source kinds. Replaces the former a3-lift-el-expression, a6-lift-db-logic and a7-lift-computation schemas, which differed only in the source id pattern, the vocabulary referenced_properties is drawn from, and the four fields a computation adds. source_kind discriminates; the conditional blocks below are what the three schemas actually disagreed about.

source_kind.description: Which lift this is. Supplied in the input by the orchestrator (a lookup on the source node's kind, never a judgment) and echoed back so the output is self-describing — a lifted rule read out of context must still say what kind of source it came from, because the coverage bookkeeping differs: el and db-body have no c4 coverage path, computation does.

method_name.description: computation only, and required there — a SVC node has many methods and the edge alone does not say which one was lifted. Must be absent for el and db-body.

referenced_properties.description: Identifiers literally present in the supplied source, and nothing else — this is what makes the output a lift rather than a paraphrase. The vocabulary differs by source_kind: property/method names for el, table/column/parameter names for db-body, parameter/field/constant names for computation.

formula.description: computation only, and required there. The computation stated explicitly in identifiers present in the method body — e.g. 'quantity * unitPrice * (1 + vatRate)'. Not simplified, reordered, or normalized: multiplication order and where a rounding call sits are load-bearing facts, not formatting. This is the field that exists because a passing acceptance scenario constrains a formula without stating it.

rounding_mode.description: computation only. The rounding applied to the result, verbatim from the source (HALF_UP, FLOOR, ...), or null when the computation does not round. Null means 'this formula does not round', never 'unknown' — an unknowable rounding mode is a confidence < 0.5 escalation, not a null.

scale.description: computation only. Decimal places the result is rounded to; null when rounding_mode is null. Stated or null together with rounding_mode — a formula that rounds without saying to what is not a lifted formula.

unrounded_intermediate.description: computation only. True when this result is consumed elsewhere at full precision, or when it feeds a column whose scale differs from this formula's. Recorded because that mismatch is exactly the kind of fact that survives every acceptance scenario and then changes the answer in production.

to.description: The source node id. Same value as source_node_id; carried here too because this object is written into edges.jsonl verbatim.

open_value_domain.description: True when the lifted rule references a set the source does not enumerate — a role list, a status vocabulary, a lookup table's rows, a rate table, a supported-currency roster. Not a lift failure: the lift is correct and the set is genuinely absent from the source. Seeds an open-questions entry so the implementer answers a stated question rather than inventing the set. See docs/spec-pack.md.
open_value_domain.$comment: Applies to all three source kinds. The three predecessor schemas each declared this separately with a kind-specific example list; the mechanism was always identical.
